newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALSE INDEX AGAIN HITS RECORD LEVEL.
newsitem.headline: TALSE INDEX AGAIN HITS RECORD LEVEL.

text.p: The bourse's Talse index closed at a record high on Friday for the second day, gaining 1.4 percent during the week to 282.60.
The index was mostly boosted by the good half-year results of the most liquid stocks, Hansapank and Hoiupank, which were released on Thursday.
Leading bank Hansapank gained 2.83 percent during the week to 152.70 kroons and Hoiupank, the third largest bank, 2.63 percent to 156.00 kroons.
A dealer said new records may be expected next week as banks results are good and the market is waiting for upward revisions to 1997 profit forecasts.
Forekspank , the fifth largest bank, may also give the market a boost as it will release its half-year results on Monday, the dealer added.
